translation.name: Yoac kekehagocac Dzadzahac gboria nga Mitiyegec

content: Agripango Pauro yofi edeec, “Geanggaoc haniaga dena negenni.” Ifi deu Pauro ye maria sinema yengena haniaya yofi edeyunuec,
“Ngictau Agripa, yudangic yeni yoacfu fainudae, imocac turunga gearu debade.
Geng yudangic neneac haifaka nga deendemanina fede, imoc negendacnec, imoc fora, amma negennemma tacmana yoacna debadeac ubana ngereede.
Ni sabacfungoc amanau kekecmemena kecerema Yerusarennu kenai, imocac hania yudangic yeni negendacdae.
Ni waracngoc farisaio singngina tongganang yeneac botucfunoc kefai. Nga haniana hennegeng anggecngo dena imoc naric edegubau.
Anutungo homemea megboriyunuude, yeng yoac imoc bangecfocnina bicngoc deseriyemmema edeyunuec, yoac imoc fora fingerude, imoc negensinggeduaeac yaguc yoacfu nanduae.

Israehabu 12 yeni hadzing tofocnac nasoya kpac Anutungo wiac deseriyemmeec, imoc fingecdarudeac negensinggema Anutu afehema kecdae. O ngictau Agripa, imocac hania imoc nenahafoc negensinggemaguc yudangic yeneng yoacfu fainudau.
Amma Anutungo homemea megboriyunukecde, imoc ngeni nocac negenggec mi angana isoc angkecde.
Amma ni Yesu Nadzaretenac, yeac kpacsiduhaac kuc sing hania haniau memabesare dema yofi anai.
Anu womong gareng enarango uakibi nenggec mekecbare kpetiac arengfora noc efea witicamau faiyunukecma yunuhomegecdeac degec, imoc hepuc amma negengyemmeai. Imocngoc Yerusarennu anai.

Amma ni naso homac yudangic yeneac kpekpeturang amaya amaya kemma ubamereng kpemeting ayemmema Yesu denggbaringgegecdeac ayemmema yunukporac ayemmekefai. Amma herebu yombong ayemmeai, imoc efea kpac amma imoc yeisac mi anai, kpac. Ni bangec goaac taonnu ifingoc kemma yunukporac ayemmekefai.
Ifi angkecba womong gareng enara yeneac dedeu uakibi mema Damaskou ua ifingoc mebadeac fainugec kenai.
O ngictauna, ni sinnu kembare naso 12 kiroc ammanu kurumennunac kperagi mong kuneng wenacac kperagia ferahade, ifiango mama ni nga arengfocna nerarannunuec.

Nerarannunuu neni bangecfu todingge kpefedacma hebiraio yoacfu yoac mong yofi fingeru negenai, ‘Sauro Sauro, ge nocac nukporac anemma kecannec? Ge ubaseri ifi angkecma yasu biringa enaragocfu geanggaoc kpena nendangguu kpendzeng kpenade.’
Ifi negemma yofi deai, ‘Kebu ge merac?’ deba yofi edenuec, ‘Nukporac anengkecnec, Yesu ninoc.
Ge yacma nanna. Yaguc neac enac tofoc tofohongic annadeac fingecgenduae. Imocac wiac yaguc hennec nga ngade edzacguba hennade, imocac enacdedena kecbesena.
Ni yaguc arengfocga nga bangecareng, yeneac mariunac mesigukecbade.

Amma ni yenearu sueguba ge kemma ngicngac kicngina merecgena kundung ngadehema kperagiu kembisia. Amma Satanggac kuc herecgena yeni Anutuaru kembisia. Ifi amma kopocsicngina kpac anu Kebu ni negensinnuma kpetiac kekec yemmeyemmea, yeneac habuu torokpegecde.’
Ngictauna Agripa, ni kurumennunac onga henai, imoc mi kpeai.

Ni hanahema Damasko kemma dzigenema Yerusareng nga Yudaia bangecac yuda ngicngac amma bangec monnunac ngicngac, yenearu kenai. Kemma yeni ubangina dzigeneu Anutuaru kpeketahema ubamerem merenggac angammeme meficgegecdeac edeyunukefai.
Ni ifi anaiac yudangic yeneng womonnu menuma nuhomebeso anggec

Anutungo garennukecmanu enacyoara deai amma yaguc deduae. Ni ngic engena mamea ngenahafocngoc tacmagec yomoc namma edengunuduae. Profete nga Mose yeneng wiac fingerudeac dema ohogec, imocngoc dekecduae.

Messia ye kpendzeng negengkecma homeec. Amma homemea yeneac enara mema yacma yudangic nga bangec monnunac ngicngac momoc kperagiyoara dekperagiyemmedarude. Yoac imocnoc Mose nga profete yeneng ohogec.”
Pauro ye haniaya ifi dema edeyunuu Festongo yofi arohomiec, “Ge negen negengtoagango ubasufu meficgegende.”
Ifi deu Paurongo yoac yofi meremmiec, “Ngictau Festo, ni ubasufu mi anduae. Ni yoac fora tongganang deduae.
Yoac deduae, imocac hania ngictau Agripa yeng negendeacnoc yearu efea deduae. Yoac deduae, imoc sufu sufu mi fingerec. Ngictau ge negen negeng monggac mi obohonec.
Ngictau Agripa, ge profete yeneac yoac negensinggenec me? Negensinggenec, imoc negenduae.”
Ifi deu Agripango yofi edeec, “Anengkecmana mi hereemanu Kristoac areng ambaiac.”
Ifi deu Paurongo deec, “Naso herea me wegena, imoc mi debade. Ge nga ngic goa yaguc yoac yomoc deba negendae, ngeni ni isoc anggecdeac numuduae. Senggoc tacduae, imocgoc anggecdeac ine mi deduae.”
Ifi deu ngictau Agripa nga Festo amma Beanike nga goa tagec yeni yacma
kendacma denegeng amma yofi degec, “Ngic ye homecac me witicamaac areng mong mi ande.”
Amma Agripango Festo yofi edeec, “Ngic yomoc ye ngictau Sisango yoara desiudeac mi debac dede, ge naric yungecna kemma kecbac.”

footnotes.text: Naso imohai yeni burumakangina yasu biringagocngo odau faiyunubesonga yasu imocngo sebingina nendangge kecgec.
